title: Simple Backup: SMS & Contacts
summary: Backup & Restore SMS, Contacts & Call Logs. Auto & manual backup.
description:
Backup & Restore SMS / MMS, Contacts & Call Logs easily with Simple Backup. Auto & manual backup with secure local storage and Google Drive. No ads. No distractions. Just simple, fast, reliable backup and restore.

Export SMS / MMS, Contacts and Call Logs to PDF, XML and VCF formats. Restore your data anytime in just a few taps.

Simple Backup is a powerful SMS Backup & Restore app that also works as a Contacts Backup and Call Logs Backup tool. Keep your important data safe, secure and fully under your control.

🔒 Secure & Private

Your privacy is our priority.

• All backups are stored locally on your device
• Backup files can be encrypted before saving
• Optional Google Drive backup available
• No data stored on developer servers
• No analytics, no tracking, no ads

Your data remains fully under your control at all times.

📱 Backup & Restore Features

SMS Backup & Restore

• Backup SMS messages to XML
• Restore SMS messages anytime
• Export SMS to PDF for easy viewing

Contacts Backup & Restore

• Backup contacts to VCF file
• Restore contacts across devices
• Secure contacts backup and restore

Call Log Backup & Restore

• Backup complete call history
• Restore call logs quickly
• Export call logs to PDF

☁ Optional Google Drive Backup

Enable Google Drive backup to store your files safely in your own account.

• Direct upload to your Google Drive
• No third-party storage
• Secure encrypted connection

⚡ Simple & Easy to Use

• Clean and minimal interface
• Automatic Dark Mode Support
• Fast backup process
• No complicated setup
• Lightweight and efficient

🔓 Premium Features

Unlock premium to enjoy:

• Automatic backups
• Google Drive auto backup
• Auto cleanup of old backups on both local and Google Drive
• Priority updates
• Future advanced features

One-time purchase. No subscription.

🛡 Why Choose Simple Backup?

• Reliable SMS Backup & Restore
• Trusted Contacts Backup solution
• Easy Call Logs Backup tool
• No hidden data collection
• No advertisements

Your personal data deserves a simple and secure backup solution.

If you have any questions or suggestions, feel free to contact us through the app.

Note: RCS is currently not supported.
